addTitle: Add an image or a video at the end
adaptTitle: Gives each cell the shape of its image: a portrait over two rows, a panorama across the full width
moreTitle: Opens the left-hand panel: alignment, title, space above…
swapped: The images in cells {from} and {to} have been swapped.
movedLast: The image in cell {from} moves to the end.
handleLabel: Move cell {n}: drag it onto another cell to swap the two images
handleTitle: Drag onto another cell to swap the two images
bgTitle: Background behind the image (handy for a cut-out PNG)
